Hi Sara — thanks, and congrats on getting set up. Short answers up front, then an itemized checklist below.

Summary:
- Yes: we can apply reverse-charge for EU B2B where the buyer has a valid EU VAT ID. Redwood will issue an invoice showing net amounts and the reverse-charge note; VAT will not be charged on the invoice.
- Docs we need from you: VIES validation (screenshot or link), and your VAT registration PDF (you already attached that, thanks).
- Payment routing: default route is to Redwood EU Billing (SEPA/wire). If you need US/UK entity routing for legal reasons, please tell us and we will provide alternate instructions.

Checklist for AuroraPay to unlock net (reverse-charge) invoice and release payment:
1) Confirm customer VAT ID and jurisdiction (you provided LU12345678) — we will validate against VIES.
2) Provide VIES validation screenshot or a PDF export showing LU12345678 is valid. (Attachment accepted: vat-check-vies-screenshot.png)
3) Confirm billing name and legal entity to appear on invoice exactly as in your registration.
4) Confirm preferred wire beneficiary (SEPA / SWIFT). If you send SEPA, include IBAN and BIC.
5) Sign the proforma/invoice if required by your AP team (we can generate a proforma).

Invoice wording we add (standard):
"Reverse charge — VAT to be accounted for by the recipient under Article 194(1) of Council Directive 2006/112/EC."

I have looped in Ben from Billing to generate a proforma and confirm the bank details we expect; Ben — can you prepare a proforma net invoice and include the reverse-charge note above?

Ethan
